name: gemini-4-argon
description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's flagship reasoning model, built for complex software engineering, deep mathematical and scientific problem solving, and autonomous multi-step agents. Google trained it to keep context across long, multi-step tasks and to turn long documents mixing text, tables, charts and images into a single grounded output. It leads the Vals Index across finance, legal, coding and tax work, and supports long decode of up to 1M output tokens in a single response.
zhDescription: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google 推出的旗舰推理模型，面向复杂软件工程、深度数学与科学问题求解，以及自主多步骤智能体任务。模型能够在长程、多步骤任务中持续保持上下文，并将融合文本、表格、图表与图像的长文档整合为统一且有依据的输出。其在 Vals Index 的金融、法律、编程和税务任务中位居首位，并支持单次响应最多生成 100 万个输出 Token。

usageGuide.docLabel: 查看完整 API 文档

python.code:
# pip install google-genai
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

client = genai.Client(
    api_key="<api_key>",
    http_options=types.HttpOptions(base_url="https://maas-api.computrix.ai"),
)

response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-4-argon",
    contents="What is the meaning of life?",
)
print(response.text)

javascript.installLine: 无需安装额外依赖（需 Node 18+ 或支持 fetch 的运行环境）

curl.installLine: 说明：macOS / Linux 一般已预装 curl
curl.code:
curl -X POST "https://maas-api.computrix.ai/v1beta/models/gemini-4-argon:generateContent" \
  -H "x-goog-api-key: <api_key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"What is the meaning of life?"}]}]}'
